```{python}
import polars as pl
import requests
import io
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
```

```{python}
url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/byuidatascience/data4missing/master/data-raw/flights_missing/flights_missing.json"

response = requests.get(url)
df = pl.read_json(io.BytesIO(response.content))
```

```{python}
num_of_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith("num_of")]
minutes_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith("minutes_delayed")]
clean_cols = num_of_cols + minutes_cols

df_clean = (
    df
    .with_columns([
        pl.when(
            pl.col(col).cast(pl.Utf8).str.contains(r"\+") |
            (pl.col(col).cast(pl.Float64, strict=False) < 0)
        )
        .then(None)
        .otherwise(pl.col(col).cast(pl.Float64, strict=False))
        .alias(col)
        for col in clean_cols
    ])
)

df_filled = (
    df_clean
    .with_columns([
        pl.col(col).fill_null(pl.col(col).median()).alias(col)
        for col in minutes_cols
    ])
    .with_columns([
        pl.col(col).fill_null(pl.col(col).mean()).alias(col)
        for col in num_of_cols
    ])
)

```

1. Which delay is the worst delay? Keep working with the cleaned dataset you created in the previous task. Compare the proportion of flights delayed due to Carrier, to Security, and to Late Aircraft. Show this comparison in a Chart and a Table. Describe your results.

Late Aircraft is the worst delay type because it has the highest proportion of delayed flights, around 6–7%. Carrier delays are lower, around 4%, and Security delays are almost zero. This shows that late-arriving aircraft cause the biggest delay problem out of the three types.


```{python}
delay_type_summary = (
    df_filled
    .select([
        pl.col("num_of_flights_total").sum().alias("total_flights"),
        pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").sum().alias("Carrier"),
        pl.col("num_of_delays_security").sum().alias("Security"),
        pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft").sum().alias("Late Aircraft")
    ])
    .unpivot(
        index="total_flights",
        variable_name="delay_type",
        value_name="total_delays"
    )
    .with_columns(
        (pl.col("total_delays") / pl.col("total_flights")).alias("proportion_delayed")
    )
    .sort("proportion_delayed", descending=True)
)

delay_type_summary
```

```{python}
(
    ggplot(delay_type_summary, aes(x="delay_type", y="proportion_delayed"))
    + geom_bar(stat="identity")
    + labs(
        title="Overall Proportion of Flights Delayed by Delay Type",
        x="Delay Type",
        y="Proportion of All Flights Delayed"
    )
    + scale_y_continuous(format=".0%")
)
```

2. Create another chart that shows the proportion of delays for each reason (Carrier, Security, and Late Aircraft) across all 7 airports. Describe your results.

Late Aircraft delays are the highest at every airport, so they are the biggest problem overall. Carrier delays are lower but still significant, especially at SAN and IAD. Security delays are almost zero across all airports, so they do not appear to be a major cause of delays.

```{python}
airport_delay_summary = (
    df_filled
    .group_by("airport_code")
    .agg([
        pl.col("num_of_flights_total").sum().alias("total_flights"),
        pl.col("num_of_delays_carrier").sum().alias("Carrier"),
        pl.col("num_of_delays_security").sum().alias("Security"),
        pl.col("num_of_delays_late_aircraft").sum().alias("Late Aircraft")
    ])
    .unpivot(
        index=["airport_code", "total_flights"],
        variable_name="delay_type",
        value_name="total_delays"
    )
    .with_columns(
        (pl.col("total_delays") / pl.col("total_flights")).alias("proportion_delayed")
    )
    .sort(["airport_code", "proportion_delayed"], descending=[False, True])
)

airport_delay_summary
```


```{python}
(
    ggplot(airport_delay_summary, aes(x="airport_code", y="proportion_delayed", fill="delay_type"))
    + geom_bar(stat="identity", position="dodge")
    + labs(
        title="Proportion of Flights Delayed by Type Across Airports",
        x="Airport",
        y="Proportion of Flights Delayed",
        fill="Delay Type"
    )
    + scale_y_continuous(format=".0%")
)
```
